d:
A delicious twist on your usual pasta, made with a rich, creamy paprika sauce without using any cream, butter, or oil. Roasted bell peppers, onions, tomatoes, and paneer come together to create a silky, flavour-packed sauce that's both wholesome and satisfying.
Ready in just 15–20 minutes, this is a healthy and comforting meal that's perfect when you're looking for something different from the usual red or white sauce pasta. The full written recipe is mentioned below in the description, do give it a try. Happy Cooking!
